purpose: Validates SWIFT GPI pacs.002 payment status code transitions against the GPI state machine (PDNG, ACSP, ACSP/ACWC, ACCC, RJCT) and checks the Universal Confirmation SLA (ACCC must be sent within 24 hours of ACSP). Detects invalid transitions, transitions from terminal states, and SLA at-risk or breached conditions. For use in agent-driven GPI payment monitoring workflows.
